# unguarded slicing of commit_sha in summaries

_echo_summary unconditionally slices s.commit_sha[:12] (and s.published_sha[:12] guarded only by a truthy check). If a summary object has a missing or non-string commit_sha this could raise an exception or produce invalid output, reducing robustness.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/cli.py` — `knowledge_compiler.cli._echo_summary`
